grupoexito.com.co: 68. The gap: button names.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.

Lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.

colombia.com: 64. The gap: JSON-LD.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 2 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.

Lesson: Validate each JSON-LD block after every release. One stray comma hides all of it.

nibo.com.br: 79. The gap: text contrast.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

Lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.

kreuzwort-raetsel.net: 86. The gap: form labels.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 115 form controls have no label.

Lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

Lesson: Check front-end library versions against a known-flaw list on every release, and upgrade the ones that are flagged.
